newsitem.title: NIGER: Niger lifts ban on political meetings.
newsitem.headline: Niger lifts ban on political meetings.

text.p: Niger, hoping to hold legislative elections in November, on Friday lifted a ban on political meetings imposed after turbulent presidential elections in July.
Prime Minister Boukary Adji announced the move at a news conference, during which he said that it applied to all legally recognised political parties.
Party officials were free to circulate and all parties would have fair acces to the media, he said.

Military leader Ibrahim Bare Mainassara, who seized power in January, won the July presidential election. Opposition parties cried foul when he suspended the independent electoral commission part way through the vote.
The opposition have made their participation in the legislative elections conditional on scrapping the presidential result and restoring the electoral commission.
The elections are planned for November 10.
